page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.vgn6i-m16-vws.5xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual workstation instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with 20 dedicated physical cores operating at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 92.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.6 GB per core, and is bundled with a single NVIDIA T4 GPU equipped with 16 GB of VRAM. Local storage is not included on this instance, and network performance is defined by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core CPU performance is positioned in the lower tier, with Geekbench single-core and single-threaded gzip compression tests scoring in the bottom 10% to 25% range. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, as demonstrated by middle-tier results in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth tests also show average performance, reaching 81.06 GB/sec for large block reads, though the overall Passmark memory score falls into the bottom 25%.

This instance presents a clear tradeoff between single-threaded processing speed and parallelized GPU-accelerated capabilities. While the Intel Xeon 8163 CPU exhibits modest single-core performance, the inclusion of a dedicated NVIDIA T4 GPU with 16 GB VRAM makes it a qualitatively cost-effective option for workloads that offload computation to the GPU rather than relying on high-frequency single-core CPU execution. Lacking local storage, it relies on network-attached storage for data persistence. The instance is suited for virtual workstations, GPU-accelerated rendering, moderate machine learning inference, and parallelized multi-threaded processing tasks.
